items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Diosa used to go out there everyday and then she married with Pupi Campo and we, we got together. She helped me tremendously.

ctx.x: We made arrangements and play over the radio; and Jack Robbins flipped and everybody just applauded, crazy, they went crazy about the number, so Jack Robbins said: "Gee, but how come"? "These numbers, they was no good." And then I like them, I said: I am a Latin, I like the numbers, and Diosa Costelo, Pupi Campo, all those numbers that became popular to practically all the new band leaders. That was the Pupi Campo repertoire and practically everyone was copying.
I see. So, about how long did those numbers stay in that file unnoticed?
